name: Drake
description: The drake is the juvenile form of a dragon between the ages of 20-115 years old. While much smaller in stature and not having a developed breath weapon, the drake has razor-sharp claws and teeth, making it a fearsome foe.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: The drake makes an attack with it's razor-sharp claws, dealing physical damage. A true hit that deals damage after mitigation causes the bleeding condition to a target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: The drake bites a creature, dealing physical damage. Tiny creatures that take damage from this attack are executed.

actions.name: Kinetic Breath
actions.description: The drake unleashes energy in a 6 unit cone, shoving all medium and smaller creatures back 1d4 units. When the drake uses this action, it must make a resilience check of 8 or higher; failure results in gaining 1 tier of the Exhausted condition. The target number increases by 1 with each use and resets after a full rest. If the drake becomes Exhausted in this way, it cannot use this ability again until the condition is removed. This attack can be used once per round.

actions.name: Aerial Tackle
actions.description: While flying, the drake dives onto a medium or smaller creature within 8 units, dealing physical damage and knocking the creature prone. If this attack fails, the drake becomes prone instead.

actions.name: Push Off
actions.description: Immediately before taking the Move Action to use their flight speed, the drake pushes off the ground, launching itself 4 units into the air.

actions.name: Soft Landing
actions.description: In response to falling, the drake spread it's wings right before hitting the ground, mitigating any fall damage.

actions.name: Trip
actions.description: In response to a creature taking the Move Action within a 3 unit radius, the drake lashes out with their tail, knocking the creature prone. On a success, the drake then moves to an adjacent position to the creature and uses the Bite Action.

traits.name: Active Flight
traits.description: The drake must spend at least 1 action per round to maintain their height while flying, otherwise, they immediately fall at the end of their turn.

traits.name: Ancient Mind
traits.description: Drakes are immune to effects that alter their state of mind such as confusion, maddened and the charmed condition. Additionally, they are immutable.
